findings.problem: stderr is directly passed as a file to the child and lacks any live byte ceiling; a noisy child can fill scarce SSD within the bounded120s transport window. Later gzip does not constrain peak usage.
findings.required_change: Read stderr through selector/pipe, enforce explicit byte cap with bounded finalchunk overshoot, preserve captured prefix and incomplete marker, terminate/reap exact group, fatal no retry; add real noisychild control.

findings.problem: SIGTERM received after the polling loop/complete and before owner context exit can set only owner.cancelled. ProcessOwner.__exit__ cleans but does not raise. With no post-context owner.check the command may return success and begin another transfer while client.stop is unset.
findings.required_change: After owner context exits and before success return, check owner cancellation and clientstop; exercise actual completion-boundary SIGTERM after original complete to prove terminal cancellation/no subsequent request.

other_reviewed_properties: Prefix compares every observed received chunk against retained local file; matched prefix represented by source pin+length/hash, first differing chunk retained and IntegrityError has no retry. Reconstruction assumes original immutable capture remains available.
Successful zero-return truncated bodies fail exact full length/hash with no retry. Metadata asset size/digest/state mismatch is fatal. Invalid metadata JSON is fatal.
Retry loop finite1..4 and per-attemptdeadline<=120s; known transient failures only; upload itself once and subsequent immutable requery, never clobber.
Existing lifecycle tracks childPID/start and process groups; tests cover actual deadline/transfer SIGTERM/backoff and TERM-ignoring descendants, but not completion-boundary cancellation.
Worker anonymous HTTP uses owned separate process, emitted byte prefixes remain distinguishable from HTTP error bodies, and actual local HTTP tests cover429/503 retry versus401/404 failure.
scope: Source-only review, no controls rerun, no publisher/producer execution. Existing23PASS result retained; findings require additive frozen revision and new targeted controls.
